nodes.label: Full-Text Acquisition Ladder (rungs 0-7)
nodes.rationale: Rungs are walked in order until text is in hand; the succeeding rung is recorded as source_tier + access_route so provenance of every full text is auditable.

nodes.label: HTML Truncation Detector
nodes.rationale: Fires on <1500 body words or one of five paywall marker strings, downgrading the record to abstract_only. Deliberately trigger-happy: a false abstract_only costs a label, a false fulltext corrupts the appraisal.

nodes.label: OCR Fallback (pdftotext → pdfminer → tesseract)
nodes.rationale: OCR runs only when the first two extractors yield under 100 characters, is capped at 30 pages, and is recorded in the rung detail; ocrmypdf is not installed so there is no whole-file OCR path.

nodes.label: Rung 1 PubMed MCP Coordinator Handoff
nodes.rationale: get_full_text_article is an MCP tool a script cannot call, so fulltext.py appends a needs_mcp task and keeps walking the ladder — the run never blocks on rung 1. The coordinator makes the call and hands text back via resolve-mcp.

nodes.label: Library Matching Thresholds (sha256/DOI/PMID/PMCID/fuzzy title)
nodes.rationale: Inbox ingestion uses a looser 0.85 page threshold than the 0.90 title-to-title threshold because layout and OCR noise inflate the denominator; titles under 25 normalized characters are never fuzzy-matched as too collision-prone.

nodes.label: PDF Library Git Policy
nodes.rationale: index.json is versioned while PDFs are not; a negation inside an ignored directory does not work in gitignore, hence the four-line managed block.

nodes.label: Acquisition Resumability
nodes.rationale: Per-record rung state means terminal rungs are never re-attempted; --offline reports network rungs as skipped rather than failed so a later online pass still tries them.

nodes.label: Forbidden Acquisition Approaches
nodes.rationale: Browser automation, institutional credentials, pirate mirrors, UA rotation and retrying a 403 by another route are never implemented, not merely unimplemented. A browser rung exists only to defeat access controls; a refusal is a refusal.
